notes.title: Deck Adventurers II will be present at the next Turn-Based Carnival
notes.notes:
Thanks to Acram Digital, the next Turn-Based Carnival will be held on Steam from November 13, and until November 20 you can enjoy a lot of turn-based strategy games, such as Deck Adventurers II.

Don't miss it! We've already seen some of the selected ones, and they look great!
